text.en: A feature is **not Done** just because “the UI runs + the API runs”.
text.vi: Một feature **chưa Done** chỉ vì “UI chạy + API chạy”.

text.en: Checklist before you call it done:
text.vi: Checklist trước khi coi là xong:

code.en:
[ ] User flow is correct
[ ] Acceptance criteria pass
[ ] UI is consistent
[ ] Loading / empty / error handled
[ ] Responsive strategy verified
[ ] Accessibility checked
[ ] API contract validated
[ ] Security reviewed
[ ] Performance is reasonable
[ ] Automated tests added
[ ] Manual regression done
[ ] AI-generated code reviewed
[ ] Code review complete
[ ] Documentation / evidence updated
[ ] Known limitations documented
code.vi:
[ ] User flow đúng
[ ] Acceptance criteria pass
[ ] UI consistent
[ ] Loading / empty / error đã xử lý
[ ] Responsive strategy đã kiểm
[ ] Accessibility đã kiểm
[ ] API contract đã validate
[ ] Security đã review
[ ] Performance ổn
[ ] Automated test đã thêm
[ ] Manual regression đã làm
[ ] Code AI generate đã review
[ ] Code review xong
[ ] Documentation / evidence đã cập nhật
[ ] Known limitations đã ghi
